Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 1a280dd4bd1d616a01d6ffe0de284c907b555504 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 22:02:16 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] net/sched: cls_flow: fix NULL pointer dereference on shared
 blocks

flow_change() calls tcf_block_q() and dereferences q->handle to derive
a default baseclass.  Shared blocks leave block->q NULL, causing a NULL
deref when a flow filter without a fully qualified baseclass is created
on a shared block.

Check tcf_block_shared() before accessing block->q and return -EINVAL
for shared blocks.  This avoids the null-deref shown below:

=======================================================================
KASAN: null-ptr-deref in range [0x0000000000000038-0x000000000000003f]
RIP: 0010:flow_change (net/sched/cls_flow.c:508)
Call Trace:
 tc_new_tfilter (net/sched/cls_api.c:2432)
 rtnetlink_rcv_msg (net/core/rtnetlink.c:6980)
 [...]
=======================================================================

Fixes: 1abf272022cf ("net: sched: tcindex, fw, flow: use tcf_block_q helper to get struct Qdisc")
Reported-by: Weiming Shi <bestswngs@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Acked-by: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260331050217.504278-2-xmei5@asu.edu
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/net/sched/cls_flow.c b/net/sched/cls_flow.c
index 339c664beff6..ab364e4e4686 100644
--- a/net/sched/cls_flow.c
+++ b/net/sched/cls_flow.c
@@ -503,8 +503,16 @@ static int flow_change(struct net *net, struct sk_buff *in_skb,
 		}
 
 		if (TC_H_MAJ(baseclass) == 0) {
-			struct Qdisc *q = tcf_block_q(tp->chain->block);
+			struct tcf_block *block = tp->chain->block;
+			struct Qdisc *q;
 
+			if (tcf_block_shared(block)) {
+				NL_SET_ERR_MSG(extack,
+					       "Must specify baseclass when attaching flow filter to block");
+				goto err2;
+			}
+
+			q = tcf_block_q(block);
 			baseclass = TC_H_MAKE(q->handle, baseclass);
 		}
 		if (TC_H_MIN(baseclass) == 0)
-- 
2.34.1

**Modifications in each file:**

- **net/sched/cls_flow.c**:  
  In the function `flow_change()`, when the baseclass major number is zero (i.e., not fully specified), the code previously directly called `tcf_block_q()` to obtain the Qdisc and then dereferenced `q->handle`. This caused a NULL pointer dereference on shared blocks because `tcf_block_q()` returns a Qdisc pointer that is NULL for shared blocks.  
  The patch adds a check: if `tcf_block_shared(block)` is true (i.e., the filter is being attached to a shared block), it sets an error message via `NL_SET_ERR_MSG()` and returns immediately with an error (`goto err2`).  
  Only if the block is not shared does it proceed to call `tcf_block_q()` and use `q->handle` to complete the baseclass.

**Relationships between modifications:**

- The two modifications are closely related: the new `if (tcf_block_shared(block))` guard is placed *before* the existing code that calls `tcf_block_q()` and dereferences `q`. This ensures that the dangerous dereference is skipped entirely for shared blocks, while the logic for non‑shared blocks remains unchanged.  
- The change prevents the NULL pointer dereference reported in the KASAN trace by detecting the problematic scenario early and returning an appropriate error instead of crashing.
